title: F&O (futures and options) trading — why most beginners lose
publisher: Artha Kavach summary of public guidance (RBI / SEBI / IRDAI / Income Tax Dept) — pending manual verification
text: Futures and options are leveraged contracts, which means a small move in price can wipe out the money you put in — and with futures you can lose more than you invested. SEBI's study of FY 2024-25 found that about 91% of individual F&O traders made a net loss, with aggregate losses of about ₹1.05 lakh crore (up about 41% on the year before), and losses were bigger once costs and taxes were counted. Profits are taxed as business income. It is not a way to build wealth for beginners, and it is certainly not a shortcut to quick income. If you still want to try, use only a small amount you can afford to lose entirely, never borrowed money, and avoid anyone who sells 'sure-shot' F&O calls or paid tips.
summary_hinglish: F&O leveraged hota hai, chhoti price move se poora paisa ud sakta hai. SEBI ki study ke mutabiq lagbhag 90% individual traders ne F&O mein nuksan uthaya. Beginners ke liye ye wealth banane ka tareeka nahi hai. Sure-shot calls wale logon se bacho, aur kabhi udhaar ka paisa mat lagao.
summary_hi: F&O लीवरेज्ड होता है, छोटी कीमत हलचल से पूरा पैसा डूब सकता है। SEBI के अध्ययन के अनुसार लगभग 90% व्यक्तिगत ट्रेडरों को F&O में नुकसान हुआ। शुरुआती लोगों के लिए यह धन बनाने का तरीका नहीं है। 'पक्की कॉल' बेचने वालों से बचें और उधार का पैसा कभी न लगाएं।
